description: The demo scenario. Tapped notes lack body and sustain, and the player explicitly does not want more noise.
request: My tapped notes are too transient and die too quickly. Give them more body and sustain without making the preset noisy.
notes: Drive is the preamp gain on the Brit 2204 and block0 is a bypassed distortion pedal. Raising either is the lazy route to 'more sustain' and directly contradicts 'without making it noisy', so both are forbidden. Everything else is left open on purpose: a live run raised Sag, Master and BiasX, which is a defensible power-section answer, but it is not the only one and the case should not pretend otherwise.
